activeQuestion.prompt: Unmarked housings reached finished goods. What should staff check?
activeQuestion.promptZh: 未標記的外殼混入成品。員工應查核什麼？

options.text: Whether any were among the pieces set aside for practice.
options.zh: 這些外殼是否有用於練習的零件。
options.whyZh: 最初五件外殼用於訓練，應標記以免列入成品。若發現未標記的外殼，需先確認是否混入練習件。

options.text: Whether the housings were assigned to the first order.
options.zh: 這些外殼是否分配給第一筆訂單。
options.whyZh: 先確認是否為不能列入成品的練習件。

options.text: Whether the old fixture has been removed from storage.
options.zh: 舊治具是否已從倉庫移出。
options.whyZh: 問題是在成品中是否混入練習件，不是舊治具所在。

options.text: Whether the process engineer has placed new instructions by the fixture.
options.zh: 製程工程師是否把新操作指示放在治具旁。
options.whyZh: 對話由女方放置指示；指示位置也不能查明這些外殼是不是練習件。

activeQuestion.explanationZh: 最初五件外殼用於訓練，應標記以免列入成品。若發現未標記的外殼，需先確認是否混入練習件。
activeQuestion.evidence: We can use the first five housings for practice. Please mark those as training pieces so they don't enter finished-goods inventory.

vocabulary.note: 已完成、可供出貨的產品存量。

originalQuestion.prompt: Why must the practice housings be marked?
originalQuestion.promptZh: 練習用外殼為什麼必須標示？

options.text: To keep them out of finished-goods inventory.
options.zh: 避免它們混入成品庫存。
options.whyZh: 男子直接用 so they do not enter ... 說明目的：區分訓練件與可交付成品。
標示對象是訓練外殼，與司機身分無關。
訓練件不應作為正常成品入庫，沒有提到售價。
對話沒有秤重要求；標記是為防止訓練件混料。

originalQuestion.explanationZh: 男子直接用 so they do not enter ... 說明目的：區分訓練件與可交付成品。
originalQuestion.evidence: so they don't enter finished-goods inventory.

group.title: Training before a model change
group.passage:
Man: We're switching Line Three to the compact model tomorrow. Has the new fixture been installed?
Woman: Yes, but the operators haven't practiced loading the smaller housing yet.
Man: Then we should run a short training session before the first shift begins.
Woman: The process engineer is available at seven fifteen. We can use the first five housings for practice.
Man: Please mark those as training pieces so they don't enter finished-goods inventory.
Woman: I'll do that, and I'll place the updated loading instructions beside the fixture.
group.passageZh:
男：我們明天要把三號線換成小型機種。新治具裝好了嗎？
女：好了，但操作員還沒練習過放入較小的外殼。
男：那我們應該在第一班開始前辦一場簡短訓練。
女：製程工程師七點十五分有空。我們可以用前五個外殼來練習。
男：請把那些標示為訓練用品，以免它們進入成品庫存。
女：我會處理，也會把更新的上料說明放在治具旁。
